title: The Silent Rice
paras: Mina worked at a small science centre on a [[hill|hill]]. On Saturday, the centre was [[open|open]] for a special show. A [[singer|singer]] called Tomas came to help. He wrote his name, [[age|age]], and [[nationality|nationality]] on a visitor form. Then he put a box of [[cake|cake]] in the kitchen for everyone to share after the show.

Mina had a bowl, some thin paper, and a few grains of rice. The paper covered the top of the bowl. The rice sat on the paper. Her plan was simple. A loud [[sound|sound]] could make the paper move. Then the rice could jump. But Tomas sang beside the bowl, and nothing happened.

They had ten minutes before the show. Mina was worried. Their first visitors were not [[late|late]]; they were already at the door. Tomas looked closely at the bowl. The paper was loose in the middle. Mina pulled it tight and tied it around the bowl. She put a [[ruler|ruler]] beside Tomas to check his distance from it.

Tomas stood ten centimetres away and sang again. This time, the rice jumped. Mina smiled and took a [[photograph|photograph]]. During the show, the visitors watched the little white grains move with his voice. Mina explained that the paper needed to be tight. After the show, they all ate the sweet treat. Tomas had a second piece.
zh: 米娜在一座小山上的小型科学中心工作。星期六，中心开放，举办一场特别的演示。一位名叫托马斯的歌手前来帮忙。他在访客表上写下了自己的姓名、年龄和国籍。然后，他把一盒蛋糕放进厨房，准备演示结束后和大家分享。
米娜准备了一个碗、一些薄纸和几粒米。纸盖在碗口上，米粒放在纸上。她的计划很简单：响亮的声音能让纸振动，这样米粒就能跳起来。但是，托马斯在碗边唱了歌，却什么也没发生。
距离演示开始还有十分钟。米娜很担心。第一批访客没有迟到，他们已经到了门口。托马斯仔细看了看碗。纸的中间很松。米娜把纸拉紧，再沿着碗边绑好。她在托马斯身旁放了一把尺子，确认他与碗之间的距离。
托马斯站在十厘米外，又唱了起来。这一次，米粒跳了起来。米娜笑着拍了一张照片。演示时，访客们看着小小的白色米粒随着他的歌声跳动。米娜解释说，纸需要绷紧。演示结束后，大家一起吃了蛋糕。托马斯又吃了第二块。

q.s: Tomas brought cake to share after the show.
q.why: 他把蛋糕放进厨房，留待演示后分享。
原文明确说第一批访客没有迟到。

q.s: Mina sent the photograph to Tomas.
q.why: 原文只说她拍了照片，未说是否发送。
